content.short: Alpha Homora is a leveraged yield farming protocol on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
content.description: Alpha Homora is a DeFi protocol that lets you supply liquidity to Uniswap with up to 2.5x leverage, effectively increasing your exposure to the pool's performance. By enabling leveraged yield farming, it aims to help you pursue higher rewards on your liquidity positions, but this comes with elevated risk, including the potential for liquidation if positions move against you. In addition, the protocol enables you to earn more trading fees from the swaps that pass through the pool, enhancing overall yield.
